how: One request per /Details/ page the 2025 baseline cites for Indonesia, as RegCompass/0.1.0 (identified, no impersonation), at least 5 s apart, no redirect followed off the host; then one request per statute PDF. 'download' is the page's statute link (data-kategori Peraturan); pages, text_chars and low_text_pages are what the Corpus extractor reads from that PDF; read_by_ocr is its scanned-document decision.
